# `expect.remove`: Remove expectation

Removes an expectation by name.

- Category: expect
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(expectations)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: delete test, drop expectation

Removes one test. `expect list` shows the names.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | required | Name of the expectation, for example `E2`. |

## Examples

```json
{"name":"size"}
```

Result: `removed size dims(lid); 0 left`
